# Multiple Regression and Model Selection

$$y = \beta_0 + \beta_1 x_1 + \beta_2 x_2 + \dots + \beta_p x_p + \varepsilon$$

```r
set.seed(3)
n <- 100
df <- data.frame(
  loc        = rpois(n, 200),
  complexity = rpois(n, 15),
  team_size  = rpois(n,  6)
)
df$bugs <- with(df,
  0.01 * loc + 0.3 * complexity - 0.5 * team_size + rnorm(n, 0, 2))

fit <- lm(bugs ~ loc + complexity + team_size, data = df)
summary(fit)
```

## Multicollinearity

```r
library(car)
vif(fit)
```

## Interactions

```r
fit_int <- lm(bugs ~ loc * complexity + team_size, data = df)
summary(fit_int)
```

## Model Selection

Avoid stepwise selection on p-values. Prefer theory-driven selection, cross-validation, or AIC/BIC.

```r
AIC(fit, fit_int)
```

## Beyond OLS

- Logistic regression for binary outcomes.
- Poisson / negative binomial for counts.
- Mixed-effects models (`lme4::lmer`) when observations cluster.

```r
df$crash <- rbinom(nrow(df), 1, plogis(-3 + 0.01 * df$loc))
glm(crash ~ loc, data = df, family = binomial) |> summary()
```
